documents.title: Loan Eligibility Criteria by Loan Type
documents.content: Personal loans require minimum annual income of ₹3,00,000 and CIBIL score ≥650. Home loans require income ≥₹5,00,000 with 20% down payment and CIBIL score ≥700. Auto loans require stable employment and CIBIL score ≥600. Business loans require 2 years operational history and annual turnover ≥₹50,00,000. All applicants must be 21-60 years old and Indian resident.

documents.title: EMI Calculation Rules
documents.content: EMI is calculated using the formula: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1), where P is principal, r is monthly interest rate, and n is tenure in months. For a ₹10,00,000 home loan at 7% annual interest over 20 years, EMI is approximately ₹6,655. EMI remains fixed throughout the loan tenure unless opted for floating rate adjustment.

documents.title: Credit Card Fee Structure
documents.content: Annual membership fee ranges from ₹500 (classic) to ₹5,000 (premium). Cashback reward: 1-2% on all purchases, 5% on dining and entertainment. Foreign transaction fee: 2% of transaction amount. Late payment charges: ₹500 (if outstanding ≤₹1,000) or 2.5% (if ≥₹1,000). Annual fee may be waived if annual spend exceeds ₹5,00,000.

documents.title: KYC Document Requirements
documents.content: Primary identity proof: Passport, Aadhaar, PAN, or Voter ID. Address proof: Utility bill (electricity/water), rental agreement, or bank statement not older than 3 months. Income proof: Last 2 years IT returns, salary slips, or CA certificate. For salaried: Offer letter + last 2 years Form 16. For self-employed: IT returns + GST registration certificate.

documents.title: Fraud and Dispute Resolution Process
documents.content: Report fraud within 4 weeks of discovering unauthorized transaction via email or phone. We initiate investigation and provide acknowledgment within 48 hours. If unauthorized transaction confirmed, full refund issued within 90 days. For chargeback disputes on credit card, customer can file claim within 120 days of transaction. Multiple disputes trigger fraud review and account flagging.

documents.title: Account Closure Process
documents.content: Submit written request to branch with original passbook and ID proof. All outstanding cheques must be cleared. Pending standing instructions should be cancelled. Outstanding credit card balance must be paid in full. Account will be closed within 30 days after clearance. Joint account requires consent from all joint holders. No dormancy fee charged if account is closed within 3 months of last transaction.

documents.title: Interest Rate Slabs
documents.content: Savings account: 3-4% per annum (interest paid quarterly). Fixed deposit: 5-7% p.a. for 1-3 years, 6-8% for 3-5 years, 6.5-8.5% for 5+ years. Recurring deposit: 5.5-7% p.a. based on tenure. Personal loan: 10-18% p.a. based on credit score (high score: 10%, medium: 14%, low: 18%). Home loan: 7-9% p.a. based on profile and LTV ratio.

documents.title: Prepayment Penalty Rules
documents.content: For home loans: No prepayment penalty if prepaid after 5 years. Before 5 years: 1-2% penalty on outstanding principal. For personal loans: 2-4% penalty on outstanding amount irrespective of tenure. For auto loans: 1% penalty if prepaid before 3 years. Fixed deposits: No penalty if premature withdrawal after 7 days; interest reduced by 0.5-1% if withdrawn early. Recurring deposits: Interest reduced by 1% if closed prematurely.

documents.title: Minimum Balance Requirements
documents.content: Savings account: ₹10,000 average monthly balance (metro cities), ₹5,000 (non-metro). Failure incurs ₹500 penalty per month. Current account: ₹1,00,000 minimum. Student account: Nil minimum balance. Senior citizen account: ₹10,000 (benefits waived if maintained below). NRI account: ₹50,000 minimum. Penalty waived if customer maintains balance within 3 days of falling short.

documents.title: Credit Score Impact Factors
documents.content: Payment history (35%): On-time EMI/bill payments increase score. Late payments by 30+ days reduce by 50-100 points per instance. Credit utilization (30%): Keep below 30% of available credit limit. High utilization signals financial stress. Credit mix (15%): Blend of secured (home, auto) and unsecured (credit card, personal) loans. Hard inquiries (10%): Multiple applications in short period reduce score by 5-10 points each. Age of credit (10%): Older credit accounts boost score.

documents.title: Joint Account Rules and Governance
documents.content: Joint account requires 2-3 account holders with equal liability. Mandate signatory rules: Either/Or (any holder can withdraw), All/All (all must sign), or Survivor (nominee gets balance). Death of one holder: Account continues with remaining holders; full balance passes to survivor if Survivor mode selected. Divorce: Court order required to split or close joint account. Dispute resolution: Bank follows registered mandate; conflicts require notarized legal document.

documents.title: NRI Account Eligibility and Restrictions
documents.content: NRI (Non-Resident Indian) accounts open for Indian passport holders living abroad for more than 180 days in a financial year. Eligible accounts: NRE (Non-Resident External), NRO (Non-Resident Ordinary). NRE: Foreign currency deposits, tax-free interest, repatriation allowed up to ₹1,00,000 per financial year. NRO: Rupee deposits, taxable interest, limited repatriation via LRS. Both require valid visa and residence proof documentation.

documents.title: Loan Application Status Inquiry
documents.content: Check loan status online via customer portal using application ID. Status stages: Submitted (initial entry), Under Review (1-5 days), Approved (loan disbursed within 2-3 days), Rejected (reason communicated), Disbursed (funds transferred). Customer provides identity and application reference for tracking. Escalation triggered if application exceeds 7 days in Under Review stage. Contact support team for assistance or status updates.

documents.title: Digital Banking Security and Two-Factor Authentication
documents.content: All online transactions require OTP (One-Time Password) sent via registered mobile or email. Transaction limits: Daily ₹1,00,000 for online transfers without additional verification, ₹5,00,000 with 2FA enabled. Enable biometric login (fingerprint/face) on mobile app for enhanced security. Report unauthorized access within 24 hours for immediate account freeze and investigation. Never share OTP, CVV, or PIN with anyone including bank staff.
